scope: SHBR primary literature mechanism review and local method definition

sources.title: Lifelong Imitation Learning with Multimodal Latent Replay and Incremental Adjustment
sources.verified: MLR+IFA explicitly cites M2Distill as GMM distillation baseline; frozen multimodal latent replay and temporal GMM architecture are baseline contributions

sources.title: PolyTask: Learning Unified Policies through Behavior Distillation
sources.verified: Task-expert relabeling of RL replay inputs and offline MSE behavior distillation, including lifelong real-robot experiments; not SHBR executed Gaussian W2 retention

sources.title: M2Distill: Multi-Modal Distillation for Lifelong Imitation Learning
sources.verified: Reverse KL of full GMM estimated with samples from current mixture; robot lifelong imitation on LIBERO

sources.title: SPREAD: Subspace Representation Distillation for Lifelong Imitation Learning
sources.verified: Identity and date; confidence-guided GMM distillation; ICRA 2026 stated by arXiv comments

sources.title: Principled Fast and Meta Knowledge Learners for Continual Reinforcement Learning
sources.verified: Identity and date; arXiv comments state published ICLR 2026; Gaussian W2 and Meta-World method checked in mixture subreport

sources.title: Hierarchically Aware Replay-Enhanced Diffusion Policy for Robot Continual Imitation Learning
sources.verified: Publisher abstract identifies interference-aware buffer and uncertainty/key-frame sampling; full method not reviewed

limitations: Queries are actual issued queries, not claims of a database-complete systematic review.
Search result snippets and AI aggregation pages are discovery leads, not factual method evidence.
No patents or all paywalled full texts surveyed; exact-combination non-discovery is not proof of absence.
No experiment performance was newly measured or accepted in this review.
